Relaxed and friendly beach-side restaurant...
Apr 2026 • Family
...with a varied menu and plenty of room. Evenings are lovely here too, with live music on the sand from 6pm (I think). It was lovely for our children to play on the sand in front of the band. The papaya salad and beef rendang I had during our first visit were both delicious but we found the children's menu lacking a little and not of similar quality to the main menu or other restaurants at the hotel. However it's also possible to order from the Italian poolside restaurant, which is a good option and perhaps better for kids. Very friendly staff here though: really helpful and patient with kids too.

Unfortunately disappointing – the value for money is lacking.
Aug 2025 • Friends
Unfortunately disappointing – the value for money is lacking.
We spent our last evening in Vietnam here and were very disappointed.
Both the starters and the main dishes were not worth the price at all.
The portions are small and the flavors were underwhelming.
The satay skewers were okay in taste, with a tasty sauce, but the chicken was chewy and cartilage-filled.
The grilled octopus came with two delicious sauces but was tough and bland.
The fried squid also had a tasty dip, but we found the portion of only eight pieces too small for the price.
The cheeseburger was bland as well, and the portion of French fries was quite meager.
Our constructive feedback to the waiter was met with a smile and no response.
We had planned to end the evening at the 360 Bar, but due to this experience, we decided against it.
